title: Statement Delivery Disclosure for Northbeam Credit Accounts
content:
Before an account in the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range is applied for, the way its statement will be delivered is disclosed, together with the charge the product sets for a posted paper statement where electronic delivery is available.

| Product | Ways the statement is delivered | Charge for a posted paper statement |
|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | electronic or posted | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | electronic or posted | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | electronic or posted | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | electronic or posted | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | electronic only | 2.00 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | electronic only | 5.00 |

Charges are in US dollars.

## What the two columns mean

The first column is the set of ways the product delivers a statement. Four products in the range deliver a statement electronically or by post; the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account and the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit deliver it electronically only.

The second column is the charge the product sets for a posted paper statement where electronic delivery is available. It stands at 0.00 on the four products that deliver either way, at 2.00 on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account and at 5.00 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit.

## Two cases

On a Northbeam Store Card Plus, a statement is delivered by either of the two ways that product offers, electronically or by post, and the charge for a posted paper statement stands at 0.00.

On a Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit, the way of delivery the product offers is the electronic way, and the charge the product sets for a posted paper statement is 5.00.
